name: human_surface_marker_coordination_v1
qualification_scope: Source does not satisfy verified skilled/professional instep reference requirements. Geometry features are surface-marker proxies, not anatomical joint center/angle ground truth.
landmark_rule: Arithmetic mean of all listed surface markers; requires every contributor valid. No anatomical joint-center fitting.
segment_rule: Endpoint difference in pelvis coordinates; lengths and directions are segment proxies.
relation_rule: Dot product of two valid unit segment directions; not a joint-angle measurement.

pelvis_frame.axes: columns: forward from front-back orthogonalized to left, left, cross(forward,left); right-handed. No laboratory-ground plane inferred.

normalization.length_scale: Median across source-valid frames and both sides of pelvis_side-to-knee plus knee-to-ankle marker-chain length.
normalization.no_valid_scale: NaN scale and normalized features; never substitute a default scale.
normalization.velocity: Finite differences of pelvis-coordinate normalized positions; includes changing pelvis frame, not an inertial segment velocity.

missing_data.permitted: Linear interpolation in time only for internal gaps bounded by valid samples, length <= configured maximum; every filled sample flagged.
missing_data.never: No boundary extrapolation, no long-gap fill, no interpolation across nonmonotonic time, no ball-marker interpolation.
missing_data.source_zero_residual: Preserve C3D zero-residual flag separately; it can indicate upstream modeling/filtering/gap filling, but exact upstream operation is unknown.
missing_data.event_inputs: Source-valid samples only, never newly interpolated samples.

event_candidates.confidence: qualitative rule confidence only; never a calibrated probability
event_candidates.foot_speed_peak: Source-valid fastest toe marker peak >1 m/s; candidate kicking side only, not contact.
event_candidates.approach: Pelvis translation onset >0.15 m/s for >=3 frames before foot-speed peak; low confidence, not verified running.
event_candidates.support: Contralateral heel/toe midpoint speed <=0.2 m/s for >=5 frames near peak; low-motion candidate only, no ground/force claim.
event_candidates.backswing: Interior minimum of candidate kicking toe pelvis-forward coordinate in 1 s before peak with >=0.03 normalized excursion.
event_candidates.forward_swing: Pelvis-forward toe coordinate rate >0.4 /s for >=3 source-valid frames after backswing and before peak.
event_candidates.ball_centroid_motion_onset: A fixed two-marker subset selected by source-valid completeness; median first 0.5 s stationary baseline; speed above max(0.5 m/s, baseline median+6*MAD), displacement >0.03 m, >=3 frames; candidate interval retains last baseline-like observation. Marker centroid is not a calibrated ball center.
event_candidates.follow_through: First >=5-frame toe-speed decay below max(0.3 m/s, 0.3*peak) after peak+0.05 s; low-confidence recovery candidate.
event_candidates.unavailable_event: null with reason; no fallback from toe peak to impact.

outputs.npz: Numeric/string/bool arrays only, allow_pickle=False. Raw source samples, validity and source zero-residual flags retained alongside processed features and interpolation masks.
outputs.json: Source and schema hashes, parameters, quality/feature availability, normalization, event candidates, sourcequalification=false and explicit null truth labels.
outputs.aggregate: One clip summary per actual acquired trial; no fabricated cohort statistics or professional reference distribution.

time_s.origin: First acquired sample in each clip, not impact.

source_frame_numbers.meaning: Original C3D frame indices; not reset or merged across clips.
